import pixeltable as pxt
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import numpy as np

# Initialize pixeltable
pxt.create_client()

# Get the existing table
tbl = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Create an embedding function using sentence-transformers with the "all-MiniLM-L6-v2" model
@pxt.udf
def embed_text(text: str) -> list[float]:
    """Embed text using sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model."""
    model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
    embedding = model.encode(text, convert_to_numpy=True)
    return embedding.tolist()

# Create an embedding index on the 'content' column
tbl.add_embedding_index('content', embedding=embed_text, if_exists='replace')

# Perform similarity search for "climate change policy"
query_text = "climate change policy"
similarity_score = tbl.content.similarity(string=query_text)

# Select content and similarity score, order by similarity (descending), limit to 5 rows
results = (tbl
    .select(tbl.content, similarity_score.alias('similarity'))
    .order_by(similarity_score, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .collect())

# Display results
for i, row in enumerate(results, 1):
    print(f"{i}. Content: {row['content']}")
    print(f"   Similarity Score: {row['similarity']:.4f}")
    print()

tbl = pxt.get_table('docs')

@pxt.udf
def embed_text(text: str) -> list[float]:
    """Embed text using sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model."""
    model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
    embedding = model.encode(text, convert_to_numpy=True)
    return embedding.tolist()

# Create an embedding index on the 'content' column
tbl.add_embedding_index('content', embedding=embed_text, if_exists='replace')

# Perform similarity search for "climate change policy"
query_text = "climate change policy"
similarity_score = tbl.content.similarity(string=query_text)

# Select content and similarity score, order by similarity (descending), limit to 5 rows
results = (tbl
    .select(tbl.content, similarity_score.alias('similarity'))
    .order_by(similarity_score, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .collect())

# Display results
for i, row in enumerate(results, 1):
    print(f"{i}. Content: {row['content']}")
